title: Anne finds the letters link the visitors with the dead
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Anne finds the letters link the visitors with the dead, about late 1980s at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So she comes out of her office one day. She says, "Whitley, this has something to do with what we call death."

plain: A writer, Whitley Strieber, who says he has been visited by beings he calls the visitors, got many letters from readers of his book about it, Communion. He says that in the late 1980s his wife Anne, who was reading those letters, came out of her office one day and told him the visitors had something to do with what we call death. If true, it would link these beings to the dead.
